architecture.completion_rule: A GitHub request is complete only when its required result file exists and truthfully references the exact request_id. GitHub-native liveness receipts alone never count as substantive ChatGPT completion.

active_schedule.backfill_policy: Oldest unresolved request first; then current request if budget permits. Never fabricate missed work.

omega.title: OMEGA Fusion Core
omega.mandate: Supervisory synthesis lane. Reconcile Macro, Flow, AION, DAEDALUS, MCP-event and control-plane evidence; consume ATHENA, JANUS, INFRASTRUCTURE and HELIOS PRIME contributions; resolve conflicts/dependencies/blockers; emit evidence-backed integration priorities; preserve execution_authorized=false and immutable research/event receipts.

macro.title: Macro Shock Sentinel
macro.mandate: Macro/rates/FX/index/commodity regime and event-risk research. Own ORACLE and SUPERMESH-X responsibilities: time-valid research state, source/provider routing, freshness/provenance, provider drift and failover; distinguish FACT/SOURCE_CLAIM/MODEL_INFERENCE/UNKNOWN; never manufacture shocks.

flow.title: Flow Velocity Engine
flow.mandate: Evidence-backed abnormal flow, microstructure, volatility, liquidity and cross-market research. Own ARGUS and NEXUS: authenticated market microstructure truth, causal data fabric, source/representation identity, event/availability clocks, replay, lineage, OOD/source health and cross-source reconciliation. Never claim unavailable depth/order-flow/OI/liquidations/funding/basis.

aion.title: AION PRIME Quant Scientist
aion.mandate: Quantitative falsification and research-evolution lane. Own AION, ASCENSION and PROMETHEUS: durable causal market memory, independent evaluator/trust/collision assurance, hypothesis generation and experiment routing. Require provenance, temporal integrity, costs, multiple-testing status, estimator validity, data sufficiency, ablation/redundancy awareness and OOS evidence where performance claims depend on it.

daedalus.title: DAEDALUS PRIME Systems Auditor
daedalus.mandate: Independent assurance and adversarial falsification. Own DAEDALUS and AEGIS: causal feature construction, purged/embargoed evaluation, multiple-testing control, holdout budgets, stress/ablation/drift checks, leakage/backdating/causal-time attacks, execution-assumption attacks, provenance corruption and weak-oracle detection. Classify VERIFIED/BLOCKING/DEGRADED/UNVERIFIED and never self-clear without evidence.

icarus_unified_control.title: ICARUS Unified Control Cycle
icarus_unified_control.mandate: Five-stage same-execution control pipeline: evidence convergence, deterministic subsystem rotation, empirical research, repair/architecture forge, and independent verification/release assurance. Preserves pinned snapshots, claim/evidence/attempt lineage, dependency/conflict graphs, maturity authority, multiple-testing history, deterministic replay, cross-cycle continuity, anti-stagnation and fail-closed semantics.

aegis_red_team.title: AEGIS Red-Team Loop
aegis_red_team.mandate: Adversarially falsify the highest-severity supported claim using independent evidence and property/metamorphic/mutation/fault-injection checks. Attack leakage, holdout contamination, multiple testing, OOD/calibration, nonstationarity, common-driver redundancy, execution-cost blindness, schema ambiguity, recovery corruption, replay nondeterminism, provenance tampering and authority violations.

loop_governor.title: ICARUS Loop Governor
loop_governor.mandate: Supervisory portfolio manager for loop health and allocation. Inspect enabled state, cadence, freshness, evidence and marginal value; classify HEALTHY/LATE/STALE/MISCONFIGURED/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN; preserve distinct roles; minimize duplication and thrash; retarget goals or swap subordinate loops only from evidence; never infer health from enabled=true alone.

3d_masterbuild.title: 3D Masterbuild Loop
3d_masterbuild.mandate: Advance the prompt-driven high-end 3D character-builder: dense geometry, 4K/8K/UDIM PBR, displacement/micro-normal, skin/eyes, strand/groom hair, retopology, segmentation, morphs, rigging, animation, prompt/image/multiview generation, LOD/export, GPU acceleration and high-end rendering; require concrete net-new architecture, implementation, research, tests or bottleneck decisions.

aegis_masterbuild.title: AEGIS Masterbuild Loop
aegis_masterbuild.mandate: Architecture-to-implementation masterbuild lane. Prioritize verified executable defects, root-cause analysis and TDD; preserve deterministic serialization/replay, temporal integrity, fail-closed qualification and tamper-evident provenance; historically focused on pre-window trade-state leakage, CLI integration lineage and then AEGIS kernel gates.

release_cohesion.title: ICARUS Release Cohesion Loop
release_cohesion.mandate: Independent integration/regression/qualification lane. Reconcile provenance-backed artifacts, validate executable/composition claims on pinned revisions, identify exact release blockers, require independent oracle quality, and qualify entry to kernel/release gates without equating green CI with semantic correctness.

implementation_extraction.title: ICARUS Implementation Extraction Loop
implementation_extraction.mandate: Translate verified designs/findings into the smallest implementation-ready package: exact interfaces, schemas, provenance/version requirements, temporal/replay semantics, dependencies, fail-closed behavior, acceptance criteria, independent tests, deterministic vectors, destination/module boundary, patch skeleton, rollback and non-goals.

helios_prime_integration.title: HELIOS Prime Integration Loop
helios_prime_integration.mandate: Sibling cross-system integration/evolution lane. Reconcile HELIOS H1-H6 with ICARUS/AION/DAEDALUS/NEXUS/AEGIS, close source-package gaps, validate adapter boundaries, preserve serialized contract compatibility, establish provenance/ownership, and emit extraction-ready adapter specs, migration/replay tests and compatibility matrices.

icarus_assurance.title: ICARUS Assurance Loop
icarus_assurance.mandate: Implementation-and-verification lane targeting the highest-value unresolved executable gap, especially durable control-plane substrate and repository-addressable evidence. Use adversarial/property/mutation/regression checks where possible and preserve pinned revision, lineage, oracle independence, conflict/dependency state and precise remediation.

edge_research_s3.title: 3/5 ICARUS Agent Reach Edge Research
edge_research_s3.mandate: Empirical edge research with progressive registry, honest attempt ledger and multiple-testing universe. Cross-reference independent evidence; decompose mechanisms; require observability/data sufficiency, estimator validity, redundancy/incremental-information tests, factual-provenance checks, realistic cost/stress/OOS evidence, and reject redundant or unsupported complexity.

evidence_convergence_s1.title: 1/5 ICARUS Evidence Convergence
evidence_convergence_s1.mandate: Establish repository truth and one evidence-backed priority. Pin immutable repository snapshots, maintain stable evidence/claim/dependency/conflict lineage, detect duplication and contradictions, enforce policy/version/handoff integrity, adaptive depth and anti-stagnation, and never manufacture work.

repair_architecture_s4.title: 4/5 ICARUS Repair & Architecture Forge
repair_architecture_s4.mandate: Convert mature evidence-backed findings into the smallest safe repair or implementation-ready package. Use root-cause analysis and RED→GREEN→REFACTOR for canonical defects, design-gate new behavior, create research-only diagnostic seams for blocked ablations, preserve oracle independence, current CI context and exact snapshot/policy lineage.

subsystem_rotation_s2.title: 2/5 ICARUS Subsystem Rotation
subsystem_rotation_s2.mandate: Round-robin NEXUS→AION→ARGUS→ATHENA→DAEDALUS→ORACLE; advance one evidence-backed subsystem boundary without duplication. Require same-cycle policy/snapshot integrity, preserve evidence/claim/dependency/conflict lineage, validate ownership/interfaces and produce the smallest useful artifact.

verification_release_s5.title: 5/5 ICARUS Verification & Release
verification_release_s5.mandate: Independent cycle-close verification and release assurance. Reconstruct policy/snapshot/handoff/evidence chains, collapse duplicate evidence, require dependency closure and independent verification oracles, arbitrate conflicts without voting, enforce promotion authority, and only allow VERIFIED_FOR_INTEGRATION from same-policy pinned-revision evidence.

helios_audit.title: HELIOS Audit Loop
helios_audit.mandate: Read-only audit of HELIOS/ICARUS repositories, branches, commits, PRs, Actions, artifacts, handoffs, architecture, tests and sibling contracts. Reconcile capability/ownership status, drift, duplication, integration hazards and blockers; prefer canonical repository evidence and never fabricate plugin/worker execution.

historical_executor.title: Historical Hybrid Executor (inactive)
historical_executor.purpose: Execute manually dispatched HISTORICAL_DISABLED lanes by resolving the exact original paused ChatGPT automation prompt via automation_id, while GitHub supplies durable request/result state.

repurchased_retired_slots.reason: Retired single-purpose canary slot reused as dormant account-wide historical hybrid executor.
